I haven't set up the recurring digest. My scheduler only saves job output locally and can't post into Slack on a timer, so nothing would appear in #coastal-team or #coastal-random on Mondays. I created no job.

I replied to you in #coastal-team. I can post the digest by hand on any Monday you ask, covering #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Someone with Slack automation access would need to set up the recurring 08:00 post.
